# Code of conduct

Pico Reforged follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful, assume good intent, keep feedback about the work and not the person, and do not harass anyone. This applies to issues, pull requests, discussions and any other project space.

Report unacceptable behavior to hello@rusticstack.com. Reports are handled privately, and the maintainers may remove comments, lock threads or block accounts that break these rules.
